3.t: Ah, what will convey unto thee what the Calamity is!

4.t: A day wherein mankind will be as thickly-scattered moths

5.t: And the mountains will become as carded wool.

6.t: Then, as for him whose scales are heavy (with good works),

7.t: He will live a pleasant life.

8.t: But as for him whose scales are light,

9.t: A bereft and Hungry One will be his mother,

10.t: Ah, what will convey unto thee what she is! -
